xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3093: Polyrepo UAT assembly: per-repo generation branches, per-repo base SHAs, all-or-nothing promote (unblocks the MYN train)

plan.title: Polyrepo UAT assembly: per-repo generation branches, per-repo base SHAs, all-or-nothing promote (unblocks the MYN train)
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: The UAT batch-train assembly engine is single-repo by construction (one base_sha, one worktree, one branch, one promote merge), so polyrepo projects like mind-your-now (six member repos under a non-git wrapper) can never get a UAT generation. PAN-1696 (PR #3095) shipped a guard in runUatTrainReconcileForProject (src/dashboard/server/services/uat-train.ts:126-131) that skips polyrepo projects; this issue removes that guard by making assembly actually work per repo.
narratives.Proposal: Extend the subsystem additively along the existing repo-resolver seam: (1) additive schema — uat_generation_repos + uat_generation_member_repos child tables, composite '<repoKey>@<sha>' anchor in base_sha for polyrepo rows; (2) new src/lib/cloister/uat-polyrepo-engine.ts reusing the per-repo GenerationGitDeps contract, one uat/<label>-<codename>-<MMDD> branch per contributing repo, global hold-out by fixpoint re-assembly; (3) polyrepo ready set via project-repos.ts contributions + per-repo changed-file union ordering; (4) reconciler optional composite-anchor deps with exact monorepo fallback; (5) two-phase promote — trial-merge every repo without pushing, then publish in merge order with idempotent resume; (6) per-repo teardown; (7) guard deleted with the routing change; (8) docs. Monorepo engine + its unit tests stay byte-identical. Full design with verified file/line references and before/after detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-3093.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing monorepo assembly logic, its deps contract, or its unit tests.
- Automatic rollback (force-push / revert) of a member repo's main after a partial publish — recovery is idempotent resume only.
- Cross-repo semantic conflict detection beyond per-repo changed-file overlap.
- Dashboard/frontend rendering changes for per-repo generation detail (payload gains repos additively; presentation is a follow-up).
- Changing per-issue polyrepo merge (merge-ops.ts) or merge-set semantics.
- Polyrepo-specific devcontainer templates beyond what ensureDevcontainerSync already renders into the wrapper folder (gaps become a follow-up issue).

autoDecisions.summary: Additive schema with two child tables; base_sha stores a composite '<repoKey>@<shortSha>' anchor for polyrepo rows; pre-migration rows synthesize a single repo entry at read time.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps existing rows readable without data migration, keeps baseSha meaningful for staleness comparison, and matches the PAN-2948 composite-anchor precedent already used for polyrepo review anchors (MIN-901).

autoDecisions.summary: New uat-polyrepo-engine.ts sibling module instead of an if(polyrepo) fork inside assembleUatGeneration.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's monorepo-parity AC demands the existing engine unit tests stay green unmodified; a sibling module reusing the same GenerationGitDeps contract per repo guarantees that by construction.

autoDecisions.summary: Global hold-out via bounded fixpoint re-assembly (rebuild affected repo branches from base without the held-out feature).
autoDecisions.rationale: Excising a merged commit from the middle of a branch is fragile; replay is deterministic, reuses the existing merge loop, and terminates because each iteration removes at least one feature.

autoDecisions.summary: Two-phase promote: phase A trial-merges all repos without pushing (all-or-nothing decision), phase B publishes in merge order with idempotent resume on partial failure.
autoDecisions.rationale: It proves the issue's all-or-nothing AC at the decision point while never force-pushing/rewinding a member repo's main (one-way door) when a publish fails partway.

autoDecisions.summary: Reconciler generalizes via optional getBaseAnchor/getFeatureAnchor deps with exact fallback to the existing single-SHA deps.
autoDecisions.rationale: Signatures stay plain strings, so existing reconciler tests keep passing and the polyrepo wiring just supplies composite anchors.

autoDecisions.summary: Guard deletion rides in the same item as polyrepo routing in uat-train.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: The tree should never contain routing without support or support without routing; the deletion itself is three lines plus a dead class and stale comment.

Polyrepo assembly engine: per-repo branches/worktrees, global hold-out fixpoint, composite base anchor

expected_outputs: polyrepo engine tests pass with fake per-repo git deps (no live git)

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/uat-polyrepo-engine.ts exporting assemblePolyrepoUatGeneration: name via makeUatCandidateName; contributing repos = union of feature repoContributions (repos no feature touches get no branch and no worktree); per repo (merge_order), createWorktree(name, '<projectRoot>/workspaces/<generationFolder(name)>/<repoKey>') off that repo's target branch, merge features in queue order with the same resolve-or-hold-out logic as the single-repo engine (repoKey passed in ConflictContext). A feature held out in ANY repo is removed from ALL repos and affected repo branches are rebuilt from base by replaying remaining features (bounded fixpoint, max features.length iterations); heldOut records the feature once with the blocking repo named. Generation baseSha = composite '<repoKey>@<shortSha>' anchor in merge_order; store writes include child rows (WI-1). Push each repo's branch; any push failure marks the generation failed (cleanup reaps pushed branches). On success, older ready generations flip to superseded. Extend src/lib/cloister/uat-generation-deps.ts with buildPolyrepoGitDeps(repos) (one buildUatGenerationGitDeps(repo.repoPath) per repo) and listRemoteUatBranchesMulti(repos) (union). New test tests/unit/lib/cloister/uat-polyrepo-engine.test.ts with fake per-repo git deps: happy path, skipped repo, global hold-out with repo-1 rebuild, push failure, zero members. The single-repo engine file gains NOTHING in this item. See PRD WI-4.

Two-phase polyrepo promote: trial-merge all repos before publishing, idempotent resume

expected_outputs: polyrepo promote tests pass including the repo-2-of-3 phase-A failure proof

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/uat-promote.ts add a PolyrepoUatPromoteGitDeps keyed by repoKey (trialMerge without push, publishPrepared, targetHeadSha, changedFilesSince, batchChangedFiles per repo) leaving the monorepo deps contract untouched. promoteUatGeneration detects a multi-repo generation (gen.repos.length > 1) and runs: phase A — per repo in merge_order, fetch target branch, per-repo stale-base overlap check (same disjoint-movement rule as lines 133-156), trial-merge the repo's uat branch in a throwaway worktree WITHOUT push; any failure discards all throwaway worktrees and returns failure with the generation still ready (nothing pushed). Phase B — publish each prepared merge in merge_order, recording promoted_at per repo via markUatGenerationRepoPromotedSync; on publish failure return merge-failed naming landed vs pending repos, generation stays ready, and a retry skips repos whose target already contains the merge (idempotent resume; NEVER force-push/rewind main). firePostMerge per member only after ALL repos publish; recordVerification receives per-repo merge SHAs. New test tests/unit/lib/cloister/uat-promote-polyrepo.test.ts: repo 2 of 3 fails phase A → zero repos published; stale-base overlap rejects before any push; publish failure → named landed/pending and resumable; post-merge fires once per member after full publish. See PRD WI-6.
